verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rule or trigger-action system in Logseq. The plugin API, local HTTP API server and logseq:// protocol are developer building blocks that could be used to construct automation. The automatic midnight Journals page creation is a fixed built-in behavior, not a user-defined rule, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
